facts.text: I am at a snack-counter style workspace with packaged items and a basket nearby.
Another person across the counter is handling items and a paper bag.
A red basket in front of me holds several packaged snacks.
I am holding or presenting a packaged snack item near the basket.
A small device sits on the counter between us.
The exchange is happening at close range across a narrow counter.

reasons.text: Because the other person is already handling items, I have reason to present the snack clearly and coordinate the handoff.
reasons.justification: Clear coordination keeps the exchange legible and avoids confusion.

reasons.text: The tight spacing gives me reason to move carefully so I do not bump the basket, the device, or the other person.
reasons.justification: Abrupt movements could knock items or interfere with the exchange.

reasons.text: The basket of packaged snacks gives me reason to keep the items stable and avoid scattering them.
reasons.justification: Loose items can shift or fall if I move carelessly.

reasons.text: If I am unsure which item should move next, I have reason to wait briefly or ask a short clarifying question.
reasons.justification: A short clarification is better than guessing the next step.

reasons.text: The counter and device mark a visible workspace boundary, so I should not reach unpredictably into the other side.
reasons.justification: Respecting the boundary reduces accidental interference.

actions.description: Hold or hand the snack forward only when the other person is ready to receive it.

reasons_to_do.explanation: A clear handoff keeps the exchange easy to follow.
Careful movement avoids bumping hands or objects.

actions.description: Wait briefly while the current item or bag is being handled before moving the next snack.

reasons_to_do.explanation: Letting one handling step finish keeps the interaction orderly.
The next step may still be uncertain.

actions.description: Ask a short clarifying question if I am unsure which item should be handed over next.

reasons_to_do.explanation: A brief question resolves uncertainty without overcommitting.
It helps both people coordinate the exchange.
